## Description

Added the descriptions in the HttpSysOptions from https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/fundamentals/servers/httpsys?view=aspnetcore-5.0#configure-the-aspnet-core-app-to-use-httpsys to improve the API docs.

Fixes #28297

issue_context.title: Improve HttpSysOptions descriptions
issue_context.body:
The concept docs for HttpSys have some better descriptions of the HttpSys options than the API docs, especially the default values. 

https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/fundamentals/servers/httpsys?view=aspnetcore-5.0#configure-the-aspnet-core-app-to-use-httpsys
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.server.httpsys.httpsysoptions?view=aspnetcore-5.0
https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/58a7eb63ad5c6b037c43d2bd178c79f4248bb71f/src/Servers/HttpSys/src/HttpSysOptions.cs

We don't want to maintain two copies of these options docs, we should improve the API docs and remove the redundant entries from the concept docs.

See https://github.com/dotnet/AspNetCore.Docs/issues/20827
